title: Token fingerprint oracle and prefetch-impact tracing pipeline
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Add a lightweight end-to-end pipeline and trace hooks to attribute per-token latency and cost to causal contributors (kernel execution, kv prefix/cache hits, batching delay, and prefetch/prefill activity). Provide a fingerprint/oracle per-emission that ties emission timing to upstream events so billing, SLOs, and regression dashboards can join traces with metrics and logs.
background: Current token-level accounting relies on coarse step timers and heuristics. We frequently see discrepancies between token cost in billing and observed latency buckets, especially when KV cache hits/misses and prefetch behave non-deterministically. Teams need a deterministic way to map tokens to the serving runtime path, detect cache shadowing, and measure prefetch impact on latency and unit cost.
goals: 1) Emit a stable token fingerprint (oracle id) per emission that can be joined across traces, metrics, and logs. 2) Record micro-timings for each emission stage (scheduler queue, batch wait, kernel exec, kv lookup, prefetch). 3) Surface cache-hit vs cache-miss deltas and attribute additional latency/cost to prefetch/prefill work. 4) Add dashboards and alerts for regressions and high-cost tokens.
non_goals: This ticket does not implement end-user billing changes or modify customer-visible invoices. It also does not change existing runtime scheduling policies; only instrumentation is added.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Every request that produces emissions includes a token_fingerprint header/string that appears in tracing spans, metrics labels, and logs. 2) Micro-timing spans emitted for at least 90% of emissions on canary nodes. 3) Dashboard shows token-level P50/P95/P99 latency and cache-hit uplift, with a queryable drilldown by fingerprint. 4) A demo of trace->metric->log join with a sample request and a PRD link is available.
design_decisions: 1) Use a 64-bit stable fingerprint: hash(request_id, emission_index, prefix_kv_version). 2) Emit minimal extra payload (fingerprint + stage tags) to avoid observable perturbation. 3) Implement trace hooks at 4 integration points: request ingress, batching start/stop, kv lookup, kernel exec. 4) Prefetch/prefill instrumentation will annotate spans with 'prefetch=true' and measured bytes fetched. 5) Telemetry backend will ingest fingerprint as a tag for both tracing (OTel) and metrics (Prometheus/OTLP), and logs (structured JSON).
implementation_steps: 1) Add token_fingerprint generator util in runtime core (C++/Rust layer) and expose to higher runtime stack. 2) Insert hooks: ingress -> fingerprint attach, batcher -> batch_wait span, kv client -> kv_lookup span with hit/miss flag, executor -> kernel_exec span. 3) Wire OTel spans with fingerprint attribute and micro-duration fields. 4) Emit a lightweight metric counter 'token_stage_duration_seconds' with labels (fingerprint, stage, cache_hit). 5) Update log encoder to include fingerprint in structured output. 6) Create an ingestion mapping in telemetry pipeline to copy fingerprint from tracing to metrics/logs and index in ClickHouse/TSDB. 7) Build Grafana dashboard panels and an example dashboard for the SRE/Platform team. 8) Run a canary on dedicated staging fleet with 1% traffic and collect coverage metrics. 9) Iterate on overhead and sampling thresholds.
observability_schema:
- tracing: span.name (ingress|batch_wait|kv_lookup|kernel_exec|prefetch), attributes: token_fingerprint, request_id, emission_index, cache_hit (true|false), kv_version, prefetch_bytes, kernel_name, seq_len.
- metrics: token_stage_duration_seconds{stage,cache_hit,model,release} (histogram+count)
- logs: structured JSON with token_fingerprint, stage, duration_ms, cache_hit, explanatory_message
query_examples:
1) Traces: find trace where token_fingerprint=0x12af and show waterfall across spans.
2) Metrics: sum(rate(token_stage_duration_seconds_sum{stage="kernel_exec"}[5m])) by (cache_hit) to compare hit vs miss cost.
3) Logs->Traces: select logs where token_fingerprint=... and join to trace id for payload inspection.
dashboard_panels:
- Token latency heatmap (P50/P95/P99 by emission index)
- Cache-hit uplift: average kernel_exec latency for cache_hit=true vs false
- Prefetch impact: correlation panel showing prefetch_bytes vs excess latency
- High-cost fingerprints: table of fingerprints contributing >1% of token cost in last 24h
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): instrument runtime and send full spans sampled at 100% on canary nodes (1% traffic). Run for 72 hours and validate performance overhead <5%. Phase 2 (limited roll): enable on 10% of hostpool with sampling drop to 20% but keep metric counters full. Phase 3: platform-wide release with fingerprint tag retention for 7 days. Communicate to Billing and Security teams and perform data retention review.
performance_overhead_estimate: Projected additional overhead: ~0.8-2.5% CPU on runtime hot path for canary config; network telemetry increase ~0.2-0.6%. We will add a runtime flag to disable full tracing and fall back to sampled metrics.
risks_and_mitigations: 1) Risk: Fingerprint collision or non-determinism -> mitigation: include kv_version and emission_index, use 64-bit MurmurHash + monotonic salt, add collision detector in staging. 2) Risk: Telemetry cardinality explosion -> mitigation: sample fingerprints in metrics, keep full traces only in sampled routes, aggregate histograms by stage. 3) Risk: Customer PII leakage -> mitigation: fingerprint is opaque hash, do not include raw prompt text or customer IDs in fingerprint attribute. 4) Risk: Billing coupling -> mitigation: clearly mark this as instrumentation only; do not wire to invoicing without separate product change.
